story.summary_en: Emma Clarke, a nurse from Leeds, moves to Marzling, a village on the river Isar near Freising, to start a new job at the hospital in Freising. Step by step she learns to handle everyday life in German.

characters.name: Emma Clarke
characters.role_en: Main character. Nurse from Leeds, England. Just moved to Marzling.
characters.speaks: Learner level: starts as a complete beginner

characters.name: Frau Huber
characters.role_en: Emma's neighbour and landlady. Friendly, retired, has lived in Marzling all her life.

characters.name: Lukas
characters.role_en: Works at the bakery in Marzling. About Emma's age.

characters.name: Herr Maier
characters.role_en: Station guard and ticket machine helper at Marzling station.

characters.name: Dr. Anna Schmid
characters.role_en: Emma's new boss at the hospital in Freising.
